items.en: Please tell me about yourself.
I have five years of experience.
Why do you want to work at our company?
This field has always interested me.
What are your strengths?
I am responsible and a quick learner.
When can you start working?
I can start next week.
Can we talk about the salary?
We will get back to you soon.
Thank you for your time.
Thank you for inviting me to the interview.
What do you think about air pollution?

items.uz: Bu juda jiddiy muammo, deb o'ylayman.
items.en: I think this is a very serious problem.
We need to give up plastic.

items.uz: Qayta ishlash bu borada juda foydali.
items.en: Recycling is very useful in this regard.
Many people are indifferent to this issue.

items.uz: Har birimiz o'z hissamizni qo'shishimiz mumkin.
items.en: Each of us can contribute our part.
I prefer to ride a bicycle.
These trees cannot be cut down.

items.uz: Hukumat yangi qonunlar qabul qilishi kerak.
items.en: The government needs to adopt new laws.

items.uz: Yosh avlodni bu haqida o'qitishimiz kerak.
items.en: We need to educate the younger generation about this.
Let's protect nature for future generations.

items.uz: Bu masala haqida ko'proq gapirishimiz kerak.
items.en: We need to talk more about this issue.
